title: GRC MCP server: scoped read tools and a reviewer-gated write
area: AI integration: tool design and security
scenario: MFH internal audit exposes its GRC system to every ControlPilot agent through one MCP server (MCP Python SDK 2.x). One server instance serves one engagement, and the only write, recording an exception, needs an HMAC approval token issued by a human reviewer who is not the preparer. Build it against an in-memory GRC store with two engagements that share control ids.
task: Write get_control_test, search_exceptions (opaque cursor pagination) and get_evidence_index, scoped to one engagement and annotated read-only
Write tool descriptions and ToolError messages a model can act on
Implement HMAC approval tokens bound to engagement, control, sample, reviewer and expiry
Gate record_exception on a valid token from a reviewer who is not the preparer; refuse duplicates
acceptance: Five tools with correct annotations and usable descriptions
No data from the other engagement through any tool
Pagination returns every match once; bad arguments and cursors give actionable errors
Forged, tampered, expired, wrong-scope and preparer tokens rejected with nothing written

practices.label: Week 4 Fri - access controls and approval gates
